crime.value: Murder by high-frequency sound transmission through a modified hearing-aid battery disguised as a hearing aid. The central question: how was Serge Maillot killed when all electrical apparatus were tested and safe?
crime.quote: Sound. High-frequency sound... they can kill. That was why there was a dead spot on the tape.

victim.value: Serge Maillot, 69-year-old theatrical impresario and film mogul, killed because he dismissed an employee (Demaine's father) in 1942, leading to the father's arrest and death in a Nazi concentration camp.
victim.quote: He kicked out my father from his company—and the Boche sent him to a camp—and there he died!

closed_world.value: Orly Airport's VIP lounge during a champagne reception and press event for Serge Maillot, with limited exits and controlled access by police and airport staff.
closed_world.quote: Through the plate-glass windows of the upstairs lounge I stared at the tarmac... the L-shaped room ending in a staircase

culprit_and_motive.value: Demaine, a young sound engineer, and possibly Martine (Maillot's wife), who replaced the hearing-aid battery with transistors acting as a receiver. Demaine's motive: revenge for his father's dismissal and subsequent death in a Nazi camp.
culprit_and_motive.quote: She helped me!... It was she who changed the battery. I wanted to kill him, but she helped me.

resolution.value: Inspector Jeannot reconstructs the crime by recognizing the hearing-aid battery was sabotaged with transistors; he demonstrates the method by having Demaine put on the device during tape playback, forcing Demaine's confession. Demaine flees across the tarmac and is killed by aircraft propellers.
resolution.quote: He replaced the battery with three transistors... tuned to each other... he turned tail—his footsteps clattering down the staircase.

investigator.value: Adam Venture, a private investigator and casual observer who gate-crashed the VIP party, witnesses Maillot's death, notices the hot ear, and convinces Inspector Jeannot to perform an autopsy and investigate the hearing aid.
investigator.quote: I happened to be watching Maillot when he died... when I accidentally touched Serge Maillot's left ear it was hot.
